_comment: Known divergences from the specification. Remove an entry when you fix it; move it to "accepted" with a reason when it is deliberate. Regenerate with: php bin/spec-audit --write-baseline

accepted.users:endpoint.deprecated:users.getWeekS: Kept for backwards compatibility until v3.0. Users::getWeekSchedule() raises E_USER_DEPRECATED once per process and points to userSchedules()->forUser(), the successor endpoint.
